Have you used the Tell Us Once service to report this death?

Tell Us Once is a service that lets you report a death to most government organisations at the same time. 

When you register a death, the registrar will explain how the service works. They'll either:

  • complete the Tell Us Once service with you
  • give you a reference number so you can use the service online or by phone
